{{Vanilla|Gravel}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Gravel''' is a loose block affected by gravity. Matcha Flavoured makes it part of a chain that turns rock into sand without digging up deserts: [[Blast Furnace|blast]] [[cobblestone]] into gravel, and gravel into [[sand]]. Broken gravel also always drops both flint and [[dirt]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Cooking and crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
* Blasting [[cobblestone]] or cobbled deepslate gives gravel (5 seconds).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/gravel.json}}</ref>
* Two dirt and two flint, placed diagonally, make 2 gravel.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/gravel.json}}</ref>

This was one of the first changes the developer made. The design video describes needing a lot of sand without tearing up a desert: "I added a recipe that let me blast cobble into gravel and gravel into sand. Really simple, really silly, but it worked. One little change stopped me from demolishing an entire biome."<ref>{{Cite video|quote=I added a recipe that let me blast cobble into gravel and gravel into sand. Really simple, really silly, but it worked. One little change stopped me from demolishing an entire biome.}}</ref>

=== Natural generation ===
Gravel generates in the Overworld as in vanilla. The pack removes gravel from [[Hell]]'s terrain generation.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.1-alpha|quote=Gravel removed from Hell (Made by HapppySpud!)}}</ref>

== Drops ==
Broken without {{MCW|Silk Touch}}, gravel always drops one [[dirt]] and one flint. With Silk Touch it drops itself. In vanilla it drops either gravel or, with a 10% chance, flint.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/gravel.json}}</ref>

Because the dirt-and-flint recipe turns 2 dirt and 2 flint back into 2 gravel, breaking gravel and recrafting it loses nothing.

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
Blasting gravel gives [[sand]] (5 seconds).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/sand.json}}</ref> Gravel counts as a path block for the [[Trailblaze]] enchantment.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/is_path.json}}</ref>

== Appearance ==
The resource pack gives gravel and suspicious gravel new textures, with several variations for plain gravel.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/blockstates/gravel.json}}</ref>
